note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and accuracy: both correctly bind the 96.00 oz (2.721 kg) minimum starting water weight to Rule 9-2c and the Figure 9 vaporized-water thresholds (16 oz/450 g no-points, 16–80 oz reduced, 80 oz/2300 g full points) to the Cooking Subcontest. The only difference is that Set A repeats the 96.00 oz starting-water fact one extra time (four near-identical claims versus three in Set B), so Set B is marginally cleaner. Both sets share the same weaknesses: heavy duplication of the starting-water fact, fragment quotes like "(2.721 kg)" that do not stand alone as support, and omission of the main 5.000 lb (80.00 oz / 2.268 kg) full-credit vaporization target and the 1.000–5.000 lb reduced-points band from the rule text.
remarks: Both extractions fixate on the same two facts (starting water minimum and Figure 9 thresholds) and miss the central rule values: full points require vaporizing 5.000 lb (80.00 oz or 2.268 kg), reduced points for 1.000–5.000 lb (16.00 oz–80.00 oz), single-container requirement, and the normal-configuration condition for the appliance. Note a source inconsistency: the rule text gives 80 oz = 2.268 kg while Figure 9 labels the same threshold as 2300 g; both sets reproduce the figure's rounded value without flagging it. The only difference between the sets is one extra duplicate claim in A, so the verdict is weakly in B's favor.
